name: Extra Favored Terrain
body:
You are a master of more terrains than most rangers.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain class feature, ranger level 5th.

Benefit(s): You designate one additional type of terrain as a favored terrain, as defined on page 65 of the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. Your bonus in this favored terrain begins at +2. Like your other favored terrain bonuses, this bonus may be selected to be increased at any level that you normally gain a new favored terrain (8th, 13th, and 18th).

Special: You can take this feat more than once, but no more than one additional time for every 4 ranger class levels you possess beyond 5th.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
